Alubilli Omkar and Others ...PETITIONER(S)
 AND The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)
Counsel for the Petitioner(S):
1. NAIDU SIVA RAMA KRISHNA Counsel for the Respondent(S):
1. GP FOR ROADS BUILDINGS 2. GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION The Court made the following:

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH  AT AMARAVATI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Sri N.Siva Rama Krishna, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Bhagath Singh, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue and Sri C.H.Praveen,
learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the Roads and Buildings Department without initiating the proceedings under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act 30 of 2013), laid the road in petitioners land in- part.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act 30 of 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The endorsement dated 06.06.2025 (Ex.P9) filed by the petitioner demonstrates forming of road in-part of the extents.

entities.text: Alubilli Omkar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings submitted instructions of Executive Engineer (R&B), Srikakulam, wherein, it was mentioned that the authorities have laid road on the existing road and all the farmers were cooperated.
Thereafter, the petitioners approached the Court.
Thus, as seen from the instructions coupled with Ex.P9, the road was already laid in the aforementioned extents.

If the petitioners did not give consent to lay the road,
they may be entitled for compensation.
This issue will be decided after a comprehensive counter.
